instrument: Demand letter from the Utah Senate President to O'Leary Digital, June 1, 2026
summary: The Senate President demanded a roughly 75% reduction in the project footprint, from about 40,000 acres to about 10,000; treatment and dedication of excess water to the Great Salt Lake; a conservation memorandum of understanding; heat-capture technology; and a public project website. The developer conceded in writing and removed 20,050 acres.
notes: A stated position and negotiated concession, not an adopted ordinance. Recorded because the concession changed the project's footprint.
confidence_note: Relayed from reporting; the letter and the developer's response have not been read in original.

source.citation: Utah news coverage, June 2026; Salt Lake Tribune, Deseret News and KSL reporting on the Stratos project
